description: Open-SymuVia provides a microscopic traffic simulator with dynamic user-equilibrium assignment and one-second vehicle trajectories. The provider is LICIT, Universite Gustave Eiffel and ENTPE. Geographical and temporal coverage: The LICIT project models urban road networks; the inspected EMob-Lab repository is archived and points to licit-lab/symuvia. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): LGPL-3.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: This is the archived distribution. Use the linked successor for current releases; the successor was not independently inspected in this pass. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
